description: Accounts in Judaeo-Arabic. Dated in the month of Shawwāl but it is unclear how the year should be interpreted given that the month is Hijrī: תקנו or הקכו (both readings resemble Anno Mundi years more so than Hijrī ones). Requires further examination. (MCD with information from CUDL)
description_he: חשבונות ביהודית-ערבית. תיארוך: ככל הנראה מאוחר.
